requests_maintenance_page_description: Maintenance jobs and purchases. Each record is a payment request that "Treasury" marks as paid or rejected.
requests_security_page_description: Security expenses: cameras, guards, access and equipment. Each record is a payment request that "Treasury" marks as paid or rejected.
requests_maintenance_search_hint: Search by description, details or requester
requests_security_search_hint: Search by description, details, type or requester
requests_maintenance_create_description: Record what was done and what it cost. It stays pending until the treasury pays or rejects it.
requests_security_create_description: Record the security expense and what it cost. It stays pending until the treasury pays or rejects it.
requests_edit_description: It can only be edited while pending.
requests_title_description: What was done or bought. It's what the treasury will see.
requests_maintenance_details_description: Optional. Materials, where it was done, who did it, supplier.
requests_security_date_description: Day of the service, job or purchase.
requests_security_details_description: Optional. Supplier, shifts covered, where it was installed, camera number.
requests_reopen_description: It will be pending again: it can be edited, paid or rejected again, and the rejection reason will be removed.
requests_reject_description: {title}. No payment will be recorded and the requester will see the reason.
requests_reason_description: Explain why it won't be paid, for example: missing receipt.
requests_pay_description: {title} - {amount}. It will be recorded as an expense in "Treasury" and the request will move to "Paid".
requests_transfer_reference_description: Bank tracking key or reference number.
requests_security_kind_cameras_descripti: Purchase, installation or repair of cameras and recorders.
requests_security_kind_guards_descriptio: Payment for guards, extra shifts or a security company.
requests_security_kind_access_descriptio: Boom gates, gates, remotes, cards or locks.
requests_security_kind_equipment_descrip: Radios, flashlights, uniforms, padlocks and the like.
requests_create_failed: Couldn't submit the request, please try again
requests_update_failed: Couldn't update the request, please try again
requests_delete_failed: Couldn't delete the request, please try again
requests_pay_failed: Couldn't record the payment, please try again
requests_reject_failed: Couldn't reject the request, please try again
requests_reopen_failed_retry: Couldn't reopen the request, please try again
requests_category_must_be_expense: The category must be an expense category
